name: ai-control-tower
description: Read-only access to the AI Control Tower (risk register, agent registry, AI budget), the Sub4Me test customer (sample data) and your n8n Cloud automation. Plus two Sub4Me demo-ticket tools; creating a ticket is the only write and goes to a demo table.

tools.name: get_risks
tools.description: List open AI governance risks, optionally filtered by severity, progress or owner.

tools.name: get_risk
tools.description: Get one risk by id.

tools.name: get_agent_overview
tools.description: Summary of the AI agent registry.

tools.name: list_agents
tools.description: List agents (e.g. everything in production) with summary and filters.

tools.name: get_unregistered_assets
tools.description: Unregistered AI assets found by the discovery scan.

tools.name: get_overprivileged_agents
tools.description: Remediation queue for overprivileged agents.

tools.name: get_budget
tools.description: Monthly AI budget by team group with reconciliation.

tools.name: list_tickets
tools.description: List the Sub4Me demo service tickets (Supabase).

tools.name: create_ticket
tools.description: Open a Sub4Me demo ticket (the only write; demo table).

tools.name: search_skills
tools.description: Search the shared skill registry (approved skills) before building a new skill.

tools.name: get_skill_info
tools.description: Profile of one approved skill from the shared registry (no skill text).

tools.name: list_skill_catalog
tools.description: Skill marketplace overview: counts per board area, LOB, team and reach, with the skills; filterable.

tools.name: get_skill_ranking
tools.description: Top skills by demand (installs, views, search hits), filterable by board area, LOB, team or reach.

tools.name: list_contracts
tools.description: List the Sub4Me demo customer's contracts, filter by status (sample data).

tools.name: list_offers
tools.description: Offers SAP made to the Sub4Me demo customer: renewals and new products, filter by type or status (sample data).

tools.name: get_ai_consumption
tools.description: AI-unit consumption of the Sub4Me demo customer with forecast, by product and month, optional product or month filter (sample data).

tools.name: get_customer_overview
tools.description: Everything about the Sub4Me test customer in one answer: master data, contracts, offers, AI units, tickets and highlights (sample data).

tools.name: get_product_overview
tools.description: One Sub4Me product with its contracts, offers, consumption and tickets (sample data).

tools.name: get_contract
tools.description: One Sub4Me contract by id with notice deadline, renewal offers, consumption and tickets (sample data).

tools.name: get_offer
tools.description: One SAP offer to the Sub4Me customer by id with the contract it renews (sample data).

tools.name: search_sub4me
tools.description: Free-text search across Sub4Me products, contracts, offers and tickets.

tools.name: get_n8n_overview
tools.description: n8n Cloud automation overview of the last 14 days: workflows, executions, success rate, categories, needs attention.

tools.name: list_n8n_workflows
tools.description: List n8n workflows with category, trigger, apps and run statistics; filter by text, category, active or failing.

tools.name: get_n8n_workflow
tools.description: One n8n workflow in detail by id or name, with runs per day and latest executions.

tools.name: list_n8n_executions
tools.description: Recent n8n executions, filter by status, workflow or category (no execution contents).

tools.name: list_n8n_categories
tools.description: The categories n8n workflows are sorted into by tag, with their workflows and the uncategorized ones.

supabase_url.title: Supabase project URL
supabase_url.description: Optional. Example: https://<project-ref>.supabase.co. Leave empty to use the bundled sample data.

supabase_secret_key.title: Supabase secret key
supabase_secret_key.description: Optional. Server-side secret key (sb_secret_…) of that project. Stored as a secret, never written to config files.

n8n_url.title: n8n Cloud address
n8n_url.description: Optional. Example: https://firma.app.n8n.cloud. Needed for the n8n questions in the chat.

n8n_api_key.title: n8n API key
n8n_api_key.description: Optional. Created in n8n under Settings, n8n API. Read access to workflows and executions. Stored as a secret, never written to config files.
